packageRules.description: Auto-merge everything except major updates (those need review) — CI still has to pass first.
vite is aliased to @voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core, which must stay on the same version as vite-plus. Vite+ recommends upgrading via `vp migrate`, so these updates are reviewed manually.
schema-dts ships as a runtime dependency of the published package, so its updates reach every consumer — keep them manually reviewed.

takumi-js is pinned via pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides because blume still reads a FontSubset field that takumi 2.16 renamed. Re-enable together with dropping that override once blume supports takumi 2.16+.

lockFileMaintenance has no release timestamp, so the default timestamp-required behaviour leaves renovate/stability-days pending forever. pnpm-workspace.yaml minimumReleaseAge enforces the cooldown when the lockfile is regenerated.
